source_mapping: Research/Submission.lean: Cholesky.cholesky_factorization formalizes the full active theorem:cholesky_factorization in /spec/source.txt (main.tex lines 500-545). The perturbation is explicitly Rhat.transpose * Rhat - A. The conclusion preserves symmetry, the exact Gram identity, and the componentwise gamma_(n+1) product-of-entrywise-absolute-values bound. Assumptions retain symmetric positive definite A, u >= 0, (n+1)*u < 1, and successful operation-level Cholesky execution on A. SuccessfulCholesky records column-order execution from a zero work matrix, sequential dot products, rounded subtraction and division, nonzero divisors, and nonnegative square-root radicands. Rounded models no overflow/underflow locally. Rounded square root is explicitly part of floating-point Cholesky semantics, as used by the source proof; the four-operation model alone does not specify sqrt. Empty dot products bypass subtraction by zero. Dimension zero and u=0 are allowed. No supporting source files were supplied under /spec/support/Research.
